description: Issue #196: the ECHO ORDER of the two optional profile fields, pinned. A profile declaring both `scope_companions` and `dispatch_defaults` echoes them in that order — scope_companions first, dispatch_defaults appended after it — and #195 appends `integration_baseline` after both. The order is not cosmetic: it is the plan's byte order, every full-text golden measures it, and a runner that spliced a new key in between would rewrite the bytes of plans whose content did not change. `profile_keys` states the whole ordered field list so this case says what it measures without a golden diff. The declared companion still reaches suspected_files exactly as in case 44, which is the half proving dispatch_defaults did not disturb L2.
